title: Delivery and initial employer acceptance bundle
acceptanceCriteria: Fixed release/SHA, guide, inputs/expected values, checksums, role/device/language/cross-project tests, and explicit employer review are recorded.

personasEvaluated.summary: No frozen release bundle exists for Phase A.1. Live delivery-plan route redirects unauthenticated requests to login. No formal sign-off protocol or employer acceptance mechanism is recorded; status remains pending.

Delivery chain blocked by open defects in upstream packages B01, B02, B03, B04, and B05. Negative cross-project isolation tests for direct ID download endpoints (E09) lack documented live execution evidence.
Comprehensive mobile (390x844) and bilingual (FA RTL / EN LTR) verification evidence for all 18 daily report sections is incomplete on the current target release.

defects.title: Missing frozen Phase A.1 release package with commit SHA, independent inputs/expected fixtures, final sample exports, and verified SHA-256 checksums
defects.evidence: No frozen package exists under output/ or specs/ for Phase A.1 (last delivery archive is output/a7-delivery-2026-11-16/).

defects.title: Hard dependency block: upstream delivery packages B01 through B05 have open blocker defects
defects.evidence: B01 (data contract), B02 (version integrity), B03 (reference parity), B04 (filters/totals), and B05 (independent numeric reconciliation) have unresolved defects and qa_failed statuses.

defects.title: Missing explicit employer review and sign-off protocol
defects.evidence: Project instructions mandate that automated tests or agents cannot sign on behalf of the employer. No employer review minutes or sign-off decision is recorded.

defects.title: Unverified live cross-project isolation matrix and negative security tests for direct ID download endpoints
defects.evidence: Live execution evidence proving non-member or unauthorized direct-ID download denial across projects is not formally packaged.

defects.title: Incomplete mobile responsive and bilingual (FA/EN) verification evidence across all 18 daily report sections
defects.evidence: Full journey audit on mobile viewports (390x844) and English locale is not archived with the release.

defects.title: Decision tree in docs/decision-tree/ lacks final verification against deployed authorization gates and export routes
defects.evidence: Decision tree routes need live validation once release deployment is frozen.

summary: Requirement B06 is qa_failed. The frozen release package for Phase A.1 is absent, prerequisites B01 through B05 remain unresolved with open defects, live cross-project authorization guarantees are unverified, mobile/bilingual end-user evidence is incomplete, and no explicit employer acceptance sign-off exists.
